text: BYSUS, in botany, a genus of molltes belonging to the cryptogania alge. The character is taken from this reconnillacs, that they are covered with a female capillary filament or down, refonishing fat duft. The feeices are 15; all natives of Britain.

parsed.faithful: BYSSUS, in botany, a genus of mosses belonging to the cryptogamia algae. The character is taken from this circumstance, that they are covered with a simple capillary filament or down, resembling loft duft. The species are 15, all natives of Britain.
